name: ApplyAI - Job Discovery and Compliant Outreach

meta.description: Fetches LinkedIn/Indeed/Google Jobs via Apify + SerpApi, normalizes schema, matches resume skills, then rate-limited email/SMS. Dry-run safe by default.

parameters.content:
## ApplyAI Job Outreach (Apify + SerpApi → API)

1. Fill `n8n/.env`: APIFY_TOKEN + SERPAPI_API_KEY + candidate
2. Set `APPLYAI_API_BASE` + `INGEST_API_KEY` (defaults work locally)
3. Keep **OUTREACH_DRY_RUN=true** until logs look right
4. Import this workflow → run **Manual Test** (or activate + POST webhook)
5. After Normalize: jobs POST to ApplyAI `POST /api/v1/jobs/ingest`
6. Open http://localhost:5173/jobs — live catalog when PREFER_LIVE_CATALOG=true

Docs: `n8n/README.md`
